text:
maya: heads up — planning to cut over API/SDK surface from client v3.4.0 -> v4.0.0 tomorrow 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Plan: canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then 100% if green. Owners: chris (canary), dana (smoke), liam (rollback). No DB migrations. Requirements: QA signoff (sam), SDK changelog (olivia), client comms draft. React with :thumbsup: to ack.
chris: ack. i'll own the canary window. i'll monitor latency + error dashboards. alert if 5xx > 0.5% or p50 up >30%.
dana: i'll run smoke tests from the runbook. can you post the exact smoke checklist here @maya?
maya: smoke checklist (short): health check, sample chat gen with token sizes 64 & 1024, embeddings batch (10), token-cost sanity check. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/sdk-cutover-4.0
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z — calendar invite sent to owners. (automated)
sam: i can give final signoff 1h before start (by 17:00 UTC). can someone drop the client comms draft here so i can scan for breaking notes?
olivia: i'll push the SDK changelog + migration guide to docs and ping client-success. draft: https://docs.redwood/sdk/v4/migration-draft
nate: no infra changes required, but i'll pre-warm GPU pools and pause autoscaler during the canary. call me if we need burst capacity.
maya: rollback triggers: persistent 5xx >0.5% for 10m, or p95 latency >2s for 5m, or functional failures on smoke paths. rollback owner liam — plan is immediate route revert to v3.4.0 via routing tags.
liam: ready. confirm I have console access for routing and the runbook keys.
maya: confirmed — added you to the routing-admin AD group.
chris: quick dev note — ensure clients are sending `X-Client-Version` header so we can segment telemetry for SDK adopters.
dana: :thumbsup: will include that header in all smoke hits. @sam you able to run the longer load test after 25% ramp?
sam: yes — i'll run a 10m steady qps load and check regressions and cost deltas.
olivia: i'll also draft a short email for the top 50 integrators + changelog. need the list of endpoints with changed semantics to call out. maya?
maya: only breaking semantic change is streaming.connect partial event behavior — migration guide updated. server will accept old marker if `compat=true` for 30 days.
chris: can we do a 30m pre-deploy sync? 17:30 UTC tomorrow for quick green-light and final ownership checks.
maya: sg. i'll create a 17:30 zoom and post the link. final checklist below — please confirm:
- owners acked (chris/dana/liam)
- QA signoff by 17:00 (sam)
- changelog + migration guide published (olivia)
- runbook & rollback steps validated (nate/liam)
- paging hooks configured (chris/dana)

Example smoke curl (will be in runbook):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Version: sdk-4.0.0" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

deploy-bot: deploy reminder created and will ping #deployments at canary start. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/sdk-cutover-4.0
chris: i will post short status in #deployments at canary start, after 25% and after 100% (or on rollback).
maya: thanks all. please post :thumbsup: when you are all set, and olivia/sam/dana — drop final artifacts here before 17:00 UTC.
olivia: final draft pushed, pinging client-success now.
sam: QA sig given at 16:58 UTC — no blocking regressions found.
liam: routing console access confirmed and rollback test completed locally.
maya: perfect — see you in the 17:30 pre-deploy. good luck!
